inForce.howVerified: Body of Harrow's own sealed public notice PDF (HARROW_PUBLIC_NOTICE___Wealdstone_FINAL.pdf) states the designation was made on 27 May 2021, comes into force on 2 September 2021 and, unless revoked under section 84, ceases to have effect on 1 September 2026.

schemes.evidence: The London Borough of Harrow Designation of an Area for Selective Licensing 2021 (the Wealdstone scheme), in force 2 September 2021 to 1 September 2026, therefore still live on 7 August 2026. A previously cited commercial source is replaced by Harrow's own public notice PDF. That notice does not define the area by ward name: it designates the area edged red on the map at Annex A, and Annex A of the same PDF lists the 67 designated streets transcribed above, so the area is matched by street rather than by ward. The old Wealdstone ward was abolished by The London Borough of Harrow (Electoral Changes) Order 2020 (https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/72/made) with effect from the 2022 elections, and no official Harrow republication of this 2021 designation against post-2022 wards exists. A mapping of old Wealdstone to Wealdstone North plus Wealdstone South is deliberately NOT asserted, because the LGBCE final report for Harrow (https://www.lgbce.org.uk/sites/default/files/2023-04/harrow_final_report_web.pdf, paragraphs 83 and 89) records that the northern part of this area was transferred into Harrow Weald ward and that The Meadow Way was transferred from Harrow Weald ward into Wealdstone North ward, so the boundaries were re-cut and not merely renamed.

schemes.evidence: The London Borough of Harrow Designation of an area for Selective Licensing 2026 - Edgware, in force 2 May 2026 to 1 May 2031, so live on 7 August 2026. Paragraph 4 applies it to the whole Council Ward of Edgware, outlined in purple on the map in Annex A. Edgware is confirmed as one of the 22 current Harrow wards in the Schedule to The London Borough of Harrow (Electoral Changes) Order 2020 (https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/72/made). This succeeds an earlier Edgware selective designation which ran 28 April 2021 to 27 April 2026 (https://www.harrow.gov.uk/downloads/file/26466/x), leaving a gap from 28 April to 1 May 2026 inclusive.

schemes.evidence: The London Borough of Harrow Designation of an area for Selective Licensing 2026 - Wealdstone North, commencing 1 September 2026 and running to 31 August 2031. Not yet in force on 7 August 2026. Paragraph 4 applies it to the whole Council Ward of Wealdstone North, outlined in purple on the map in Annex A. Wealdstone North is confirmed as a current Harrow ward in the Schedule to The London Borough of Harrow (Electoral Changes) Order 2020 (https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/72/made). It takes effect the same day the 2021 Wealdstone designation ceases (1 September 2026), so there is no gap, but note the designated area is the current Wealdstone North ward and is not identical to the street list of the 2021 scheme.
